card.name: Small words in advocacy and struggle texts
card.fires_on: Short linking words (from, to, on, for, the) in web text about causes, donations, activism, or resistance struggles, usually just before a noun like support, rescue, or fight.

modes.label: Appeals for support
modes.description: Small words in nonprofit appeals asking readers for backing.
modes.example: That means, we rely on support<< from>> our readers.

modes.label: Resistance and revolution history
modes.description: Small words in accounts of escape, uprising, or revolution.
modes.example: but returned<< to>> Maryland shortly after to rescue her family.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about struggle and resistance, such as fighting, guerrilla, breakthrough, and self-rescue.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in activist or fundraising writing, where a word about struggle or fighting may come next.
